metadata.project_title: The Haptic Petting Zoo: Tactile Sound & Open Kinetic Hardware
metadata.notes: Direct Project costs capped at $91,200.00 under Exhibit B. Split-receipt itemization active in purchases_log to strictly isolate eligible Haptic Zoo expenses from personal/other project items on shared vendor orders.

disbursements.title: Execution of Agreement & Delivery of Form W-9
disbursements.conditions: Signed Fiscal Sponsorship & Exhibit B contract, delivery of W-9 to Sponsor.
disbursements.notes: Working capital in hand for initial tooling, Q4 2026 R&D, prototype assembly, and 11/11 bulk hardware procurement.

disbursements.title: Completion of Prototyping Phase
disbursements.conditions: Validation of core multi-sensory transit prototype (Nov 14 Control+H preview & Dec 12 CymaSpace reveal), firmware architecture, and enclosure feasibility.
disbursements.notes: Targeted for January 2027 to shelter 2026 income and avoid unnecessary 2026 SE/income tax liability.

disbursements.title: Fabrication Midpoint & OCF Midpoint Interview
disbursements.conditions: 50% hardware assembly completed at Control+H, OCF mid-term progress interview.

disbursements.title: Final Assembly & Calibration Complete
disbursements.conditions: All 10 interactive touring stations fabricated, wired, calibrated, and field-tested.
disbursements.notes: Final integration of Pelican Air transit hardware.

disbursements.title: Public Exhibition Debut
disbursements.conditions: Formal public touring premiere in Oregon with community partners.

disbursements.title: Phase 1 Fabrication Accounting Delivered to Sponsor

activities_log.title: Fiscal Sponsorship & Exhibit B Budget Finalization
activities_log.description: Reviewed and executed Fiscal Sponsorship Agreement with Jonathan Hannis (PDX Hackerspace / Control+H). Finalized Exhibit B Direct Costs budget ($91,200 cap), drafted Grantee Review Response Memo resolving the $200 unallocated line item to Line 5, and submitted Form W-9.

activities_log.title: OCF Strategic Check-in & Teleprompter Roadmapping
activities_log.description: Prepared interactive OCF Check-in Teleprompter HUD and conducted one-on-one strategic alignment meeting with Chey at Oregon Community Foundation. Outlined Q4 2026 low-burn prototyping during college degree completion, Q1 2027 full fabrication ramp, and rural Oregon tour venue matchmaking.

activities_log.title: Corvallis Kaleidoscope, PRAx & OSU Graand Kinetic Challenge Proposal
activities_log.description: Drafted and submitted Deaf-led science festival proposal with Susan Anderson (CymaSpace) to Corvallis Kaleidoscope & OSU Graand Kinetic Challenge (currently in committee review with Stacey & Heather). Proposed 'Torque, Resonance & Light' kinetic gear train + tactile frequency station.

activities_log.title: World Deaf Timberfest (WDT) 100-Kid Solderless STEM Workshop Scoping
activities_log.description: Negotiated workshop scope with WDT organizers, securing initial $1,000 budget commitment to lead a hands-on tactile STEM workshop for 100 Deaf youth. Architected solderless plug-and-play kit assembly (eliminating hot soldering iron hazards while students sign in ASL).

activities_log.title: The Portland Tactile Dispatch Web Portal & Frequency Synthesizer
activities_log.description: Adapted modular codebase components into a standalone, mobile-responsive broadsheet news-gazette portal. Integrated interactive Web Audio canvas frequency synthesizer (5Hz–300Hz mechanoreceptor mapping), Teardown 2026 video showcase, and pre-filled mailto: onboarding for Control+H makers.

activities_log.title: Glue Audio-to-Haptics PWM Synthesizer & Zero-Hardware Smartphone Zoo R&D
activities_log.description: Engineered real-time sub-bass transient detector, 155Hz LRA resonant hold math (90ms envelope + non-linear velocity S-curve), and 48123 UDP waveform telemetry HUD. Serves both as the core audio-to-haptic DSP testbed for the Haptic Zoo and an accessible 'Bring-Your-Own-Smartphone Mini-Haptic Zoo' so anyone can experience tactile sound physics at home without extra gear.

activities_log.title: Parametric Tactile Controller PCB & Web Configurator (38x38mm Square PCBA)
activities_log.description: Designed and verified the 38x38mm Compact Audio-Motion Square PCB featuring dual AO3400A low-side MOSFET haptic PWM drivers, flyback protection, dual mics, and 3D/2D browser-based parametric configurator—enabling Control+H collaborators to customize and export turnkey JLCPCB SMT boards without hand-soldering tiny SOT-23 packages.

activities_log.title: Pelican Lid Vision Architecture & 11/11 Bulk BOM Sourcing
activities_log.description: Architected overhead lid spatial tracking (ESP32-S3-CAM + VL53L1X ToF failover across 3 proximity zones) and sourced the 11/11 bulk hardware BOM for 100 solderless WDT youth kits and Dec 12 prototype critters.

activities_log.title: Hacker Initiative Grant ($2k), Teardown 2027, CES 2027 & Haptic Dinner Portal
activities_log.description: Submitted 'The Haptic Zoo Explorer' $2,000 grant application to The Hacker Initiative (~1.0 hr). Submitted Haptic Petting Zoo proposal to Crowd Supply Teardown 2027 ($210 pass secured), coordinated CES 2027 booth outreach, and built the Dec 12 CymaSpace Haptic Dinner reservation portal & flyer with Control+H cross-promotion (~3.5 hrs). Note: 15 hrs for HHF Magazine article & Creston Deaf classroom workshop are billed under NEA/CymaSpace and excluded here.

activities_log.title: Prototype #1 3D Printing, Iridescent Finishing & Bench Verification
activities_log.description: Ordered MEIJIA waterproof enclosure and 2.8" ESP32 touch display; received 4x spools of functional black PLA and Rust-Oleum iridescent color-shift spray finish. Verified 38x38mm Square PCBA traces on the bench and started printing/finishing Prototype #1 using existing lab hardware ahead of the Saturday Nov 14 Control+H showcase (carpooling from Philomath with Control+H President Jonathan Hannis).
